commits.subject: chore(ajc): correct the authorship stamped on all 164 modules
commits.summary: **Attribution fix.** 138 of 164 files carried `Copyright (c) 2026 Christian Merten` / `Authors: Christian Merten`, copied from the seed statement file `references/challenge.lean`. Christian Merten proposed the challenge; he did not write this code. All 164 modules now carry the header the sibling project Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild already settled on — `Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.` / `Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors` — which also clears the four `linter.style.header` warnings ("Copyright too short!", "Copyright line should end with . All rights reserved.") and gives Picard/GlueDescent.lean, the one module with no header at all, one.
